source: Exact sRGB hex arrays in src/presets.ts; no sampling, fitting or color changes.

method.nearestNeighbors: Each point contributes one distance; a mutual pair appears twice.
method.mst: Prim MST over complete graph, full 3D OKLab distance; SVG is a 2D projection.
method.hue: Smallest clockwise arc after removing largest empty hue gap; 0 degrees is a continuous seam.
method.families: Named human interpretation using declared hue intervals, not data-derived discrete clusters.
